Are you planning to queue up at the Apple Store and buy the iPhone Duo in person? Here's Apple's official statement on the new phone's in-store availability.

Below is Apple's official statement on purchasing the iPhone Duo in person at Apple Store with available stock

Last week, shortly after iPhone Duo pre-orders went live, a large number of orders immediately saw shipping delays, and many people are planning to try their luck at Apple Store on October 23, hoping to snag one in person.

Apple today issued a statement to 9to5Mac outlining the expected in-store stock situation at its retail locations worldwide.

Below is Apple's official statement:

"On Friday morning, our team is looking forward to welcoming customers at Apple Store to experience the iPhone Duo and our outstanding lineup of iPhone products in person. Apple Store will have a limited quantity of iPhone Duo available for walk-in customers, and we will work hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as quickly as possible."

The company has confirmed that it has set aside a portion of iPhone Duo units for walk-in customers at Apple Store. However, due to strong demand, there's a high chance they will sell out very quickly.

Below are the countries and regions where the iPhone Duo will be available in-store for walk-in purchases: the United States, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Mexico, Germany, Macau, the Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Kingdom, and most stores in Italy.

The most upvoted comment was posted by JP

Hilarious! Scalpers are waiting for you to fail. Six weeks after the Pro version launched, they were still first in line at the door to hoard stock.

Below are the regions that only accept online reservations for in-store pickup, with no walk-in purchases available: mainland China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, and the UAE.

If you can't get your hands on an iPhone Duo on launch day, the good news is that there are ongoing reports that the shipping dates for iPhone Duo pre-orders are being moved up.

Of course, not every order will be advanced. However, if you haven't placed an order yet and can't buy one on Friday, the current estimated January shipping date could be significantly pulled forward.

Are you planning to try your luck at Apple Store on Friday to buy the iPhone Duo? What time will you go and queue up? Feel free to share in the comments.
